initialExam.title: IDBI Executive 2026
initialExam.description: IDBI Bank Executive recruitment for entry-level officer positions. Candidates work in various banking operations including retail, corporate, and treasury functions.
initialExam.eligibility: Graduate from a recognized university with 60% marks
initialExam.qualifications: Graduation in any discipline with minimum 60% marks
initialExam.syllabus: Reasoning Ability, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, General/Economy/Banking Awareness.
initialExam.examPattern: Online Test: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Negative marking: 0.25 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Test → Interview → Document Verification → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Executive in IDBI Bank branches handling banking operations
initialExam.careerGrowth: Executive → Assistant Manager → Manager → Senior Manager → Chief Manager → AGM → DGM → GM.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit idbibank.in 2. Go to Careers 3. Register 4. Fill form 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LFC, Pension (NPS), Vehicle/Housing Loan benefits

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
